quiz.q: From a geo-strategic perspective, why is a friendly regime in Afghanistan crucial for India's defense planning?
options: It secures direct overland pipeline routes to import energy from the Persian Gulf region
It allows India to open a second front to pressure Pakistan during a war
It enables India to deploy nuclear deterrent assets along Pakistan's western border regions
It eliminates Russian and Chinese diplomatic influence throughout the broader Central Asian region
quiz.why: A friendly Afghanistan ensures India can open a second front against Pakistan in the event of war.

quiz.q: What does Pakistan primarily seek to achieve through its doctrine of strategic depth in Afghanistan?
options: Controlling Afghan rulers to prevent Pashtun nationalism and counter Indian regional influence
Formally annexing Afghan territory to permanently resolve the disputed colonial Durand Line
Establishing permanent military bases in Central Asia to resist Russian geopolitical expansion
Securing exclusive transit rights to build commercial energy corridors to Gwadar port
quiz.why: Pakistan seeks to control Afghan rulers to neutralize Pashtun territorial claims and prevent Indian encirclement.

quiz.q: Why was India's role in post-2001 Afghanistan primarily restricted to soft power and economic reconstruction?
options: The United Nations charter prohibited non-NATO member nations from deploying security personnel
India signed a non-interference pact with the Taliban regarding internal Afghan security
The United States accommodated Pakistani objections against any Indian military or peacekeeping presence
The Afghan government refused foreign infrastructure assistance to maintain its non-aligned diplomatic status
quiz.why: The United States restricted India to soft power because Pakistan strongly opposed any Indian security role.

quiz.q: What major diplomatic shift motivated India to sign a Strategic Partnership Agreement with Afghanistan in 2011?
options: The complete withdrawal of American and NATO military troops from all Afghan airbases
A formal request from the United States urging India to assume regional security duties
Growing Chinese and Russian joint military intervention in support of the Afghan armed forces
Isolation after the 2010 London Conference accepted reconciliation with the good Taliban
quiz.why: India felt diplomatically isolated when the 2010 London Conference endorsed talks with the good Taliban.
